focus: Safest integration boundary in Claude CLI and Codex CLI

label: Claude MessageDisplay is display-only; displayContent replaces rendered text, transcript keeps original
MessageDisplay fires once per message in claude -p mode with index 0, final true, full delta
MessageDisplay default timeout lowered to 10s; reference uses 60s
transcript_path may lag; docs recommend last_assistant_message on Stop/SubagentStop
message_id is not the API msg id; cannot correlate with transcript
suppressOutput hides hook stdout from transcript; not a renderer replacement
claude -p --output-format stream-json is a second safe pipeline-owner surface
Codex App Server JSON-RPC streams item/agentMessage/delta and turn/completed
Codex turn/interrupt and turn/steer exist; thread/inject_items mutates model context
Codex hooks have no display-replacement event; context injection only
codex exec is plain-text one-shot; caller must own terminal pipeline
